answer: Duplicate identities are detected when claims collide, and attackers must forfeit bonded stake per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical attestations: each agent bonds tokens plus a verifiable real-world resource claim, such as a mapped karst spring, a tundra sensor site, or a registered cedar grove, reviewed by peers. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
